# OPF v0.2.8

## English

Installer-only releases and two Windows installer editions.

### Release assets

Releases now contain **installers only** (no loose CLI/TUI/GUI binaries):

- Linux `.run`: amd64 and arm64.
- Windows **CLI/TUI** installer: amd64 and arm64.
- Windows **Full** installer: amd64 and arm64.
- macOS `.pkg`: amd64 and arm64.
- `SHA256SUMS`.

Nine assets in total.

### Windows CLI/TUI installer

`opf-CLI-installer-windows-amd64.zip` / `...arm64.zip`

Raw Go wizard with **Bundle (TUI + CLI)**, **TUI only** and **CLI only**. No GUI
component. Same folder default (`C:\Program Files\OPF`), user PATH, database,
optional TUI launch and uninstaller as before. The installer and payload are raw
executables accepted by Cortex XDR.

### Windows Full installer

`opf-Full-installer-windows-amd64.zip` / `...arm64.zip`

Graphical **Inno Setup** wizard with **Bundle (GUI + TUI + CLI)**, **GUI only**,
**TUI only** and **CLI only**. It asks for the folder (default
`C:\Program Files\OPF`), updates the user PATH, creates the Start Menu shortcut,
creates `%LocalAppData%\OPF\data\opf.db`, offers to open the GUI/TUI and provides
an uninstaller. Inno Setup is a packed executable; code signing or an endpoint
allow-list may be required on Cortex XDR hosts.

### Notes

- Linux and macOS keep their native `.run` and `.pkg` installers.
- The standalone binary assets are intentionally no longer published.

## Português (BR)

Releases somente com instaladores e duas edições de instalador Windows.

### Ativos da release

As releases agora contêm **somente instaladores** (sem binários soltos de
CLI/TUI/GUI):

- Linux `.run`: amd64 e arm64.
- Windows **CLI/TUI**: amd64 e arm64.
- Windows **completo**: amd64 e arm64.
- macOS `.pkg`: amd64 e arm64.
- `SHA256SUMS`.

Nove ativos no total.

### Instalador Windows CLI/TUI

`opf-CLI-installer-windows-amd64.zip` / `...arm64.zip`

Wizard Go bruto com **Bundle (TUI + CLI)**, **somente TUI** e **somente CLI**.
Sem componente GUI. Mantém pasta padrão (`C:\Program Files\OPF`), PATH do
usuário, banco, opção de abrir a TUI e desinstalador. Instalador e payload são
executáveis brutos aceitos pelo Cortex XDR.

### Instalador Windows completo

`opf-Full-installer-windows-amd64.zip` / `...arm64.zip`

Wizard gráfico **Inno Setup** com **Bundle (GUI + TUI + CLI)**, **somente GUI**,
**somente TUI** e **somente CLI**. Pergunta a pasta (padrão
`C:\Program Files\OPF`), atualiza o PATH do usuário, cria o atalho no Menu
Iniciar, cria `%LocalAppData%\OPF\data\opf.db`, oferece abrir a GUI/TUI e inclui
desinstalador. O Inno Setup é um executável empacotado; assinatura ou allow-list
no Cortex XDR pode ser necessária.

### Observações

- Linux e macOS mantêm os instaladores nativos `.run` e `.pkg`.
- Os binários soltos não são mais publicados de propósito.
